1992. Balanced Parenthesis Checker

90

Hard

Problem Statement

Given a string containing only round brackets, determine whether the brackets are balanced using a stack.

Description

Read a string consisting only of the characters '(' and ')'. Use a stack to check whether every opening bracket has a matching closing bracket in the correct order. Push each opening bracket onto the stack; when a closing bracket is seen, it must match the most recently pushed opening bracket.
input_spec: A single line containing a string s (1 ≤ length of s ≤ 100) made up only of '(' and ')' characters.
output_spec: Print "Balanced" if every bracket is correctly matched and nested, otherwise print "Not Balanced".
